contract.assumptions: Immediate proposed coupon gate, with repeated feed contacts and harvests; 10 kg/m^2/h and >=94% recovery are later unachieved targets.
contract.costs: Proposed <=1 cm^2 supported coupon, isotope assay, impurity and carbon/scaffold analysis and simultaneous metered V/I/T/product measurement; cost/availability UNKNOWN.

assumptions: Maintained connected Fe source/sink, actual dirty-ore mobility and open path; no free oxide-to-atom admission.
Linear electrical/transport model, independent material feed/harvest per cell, isolated conducting products during power, finite measured contacts and conductivity.
Clean hot-Fe shell coefficients, solid plug and independently conducting CNT are different models; do not combine their optimistic coefficients.
field_details.conservation_and_thermodynamics: Integral export<=fresh admission+preloaded inventory; Fe/gangue/H2/carbon/scaffold mass balance required. Series preserves ideal power. Curvature/backstress can oppose electromigration; no energy saving follows from avoided gangue melting alone.
field_details.energy_balance: Optimistic active ~0.297 MWh/t versus ~0.260 MWh/t avoided gangue duty; no established gain before contacts. Charge H2 generation, ore/preheat/recuperation, every contact/lead, scaffold/carbon, feed renewal, gangue/lost Fe, purity finishing and final melting for equal molten-output comparison.
field_details.error_budget: Exclude all preload/collector contamination, match source temperature and total power, bound isotope/mass/impurity detection, measure local contact losses and path continuity.
field_details.governing_equations: J=(2f/a) Ds Gamma_s/(RT) [Z*F E-d_x mu]; mu=mu0+gamma Vm curvature+Vm sigma_h+RT ln activity. I=jA/N, V=Nv, P=jAv; P_contacts/A>=sum rho_c j^2/kappa_c; V_gap/A>=j H^2/(sigma eta v)*(N_gap/N)^2.
field_details.input_acquisition: Acquire continuing isotope-labelled feed-to-path admission, accessible connected Fe fraction, actual source/sink contact and product removal with impurity and scaffold balance.
field_details.materials: Fe/oxide/gangue, H2/H2O, CNT/scaffold and impurity transport; actual contact continuity, wet-ore diffusion, dewetting, carbide/wall consumption and product diffusion barriers unvalidated.
field_details.reliability: Sustained replenishment/harvest beyond preload, preserved confinement and actual mobility under wet H2/ore required; no life/service interval established.
field_details.resources: Proposed <=1 cm^2 supported coupon, isotope assay, impurity and carbon/scaffold analysis and simultaneous metered V/I/T/product measurement; cost/availability UNKNOWN.
field_details.units_and_tolerances: Source optimistic T=1163 K,a=L=30 nm,f=.2,3 nm conducting shell,sigma=1e6 S/m,Z*=10 are assumptions. Actual tolerances, contact rho_c and signal uncertainty UNKNOWN.

contract.obstruction: Prepared pure-Fe nanotransport does not supply continual oxide/ore Fe admission, accessible connected fraction, purity, durability or a competitive full process.

statement.problem: Recover Fe from fine gangue-rich ore as a separated solid stream without requiring gangue melting, if sustained selective ore-to-path admission can be demonstrated.
statement.proposed_mechanism: H2 reduction plus confined moving/regrowing Fe plug and independent conducting wall; isolated electrical-series/material-parallel batch collection. All input/output interfaces remain to be acquired.

target.comparator: Matched no-ore/preloaded Fe, pure-Fe, bias-off/reversed and blocked-pore controls first; full ore economics against equal-output industrial comparators later.
